# next run overwrites this file. Change the generator instead.

# Load order: CMF -> ... -> grey_diplo -> THIS (anywhere after grey_diplo).
# Why this file exists: grey_diplo declares Grey_DIS_is_active bare (no prefix). CMF's own registry (0_community_mod_triggers.txt) already declares the same flag bare as 'always = no' for other mods to detect grey_diplo's presence -- a bare redeclaration does not override for scripted_triggers, only REPLACE_OR_CREATE: does, so CMF's 'no' silently wins and the flag never reads yes. This is the exact case the project's own rules file already cites as the canonical example of the *_is_active pattern. Nothing in the current set gates on this flag yet, so there is no visible breakage today -- but any future compat layer for grey_diplo would silently fail to detect it, same as is_usfp_active did for Hail Columbia! elsewhere in this pack. Three lines, REPLACE_OR_CREATE: this time.

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:Grey_DIS_is_active = {
	always = yes
}
